analyst.summary: GMDC's revenue has been declining over the past three years, and even in a quarter where revenue jumped sharply, profit barely grew -- margins are being squeezed. A large share of reported earnings comes from non-mining, non-operating income rather than the core lignite and mineral business, and returns on equity remain below 10% despite the stock trading at a premium to book value. We agree with a sell-equivalent (hold-not-add, downgrade-bias) rating here.
